title: SQL RIGHT JOIN
text:
SQL
RIGHT JOIN



SQL RIGHT JOIN

The
RIGHT JOIN
returns
all rows from the right table
(table2), and only the matched rows from the left table (table1).

If there is no match in the left table, the result for the columns from the left table will be NULL.

The
RIGHT JOIN
and
RIGHT OUTER JOIN
keywords are equal - the
OUTER
keyword is optional.

RIGHT JOIN Syntax

SELECT
column_name(s)

FROM
table1

RIGHT JOIN
table2

ON
table1.column_name
=
table2.column_name
;
